description: This Java class defines a custom JMeter sampler named 'HonoCommanderSampler' that extends 'HonoSampler' and implements 'ThreadListener'. It manages sending commands via the 'HonoCommander' client during JMeter tests, handling thread lifecycle events, and providing configuration for command properties such as command type, payload, timeout, and reconnect attempts.

classes.name: HonoCommanderSampler
classes.description: A custom JMeter sampler that interacts with the Hono system, manages command execution, and handles thread lifecycle events for testing purposes.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Executes the sampling logic by creating and populating a HonoCommanderSampleResult, then invoking the sample method on HonoCommander.

methods.name: threadStarted
methods.description: Initializes the HonoCommander instance when a test thread starts, handling startup errors.

methods.name: threadFinished
methods.description: Closes the HonoCommander instance when a test thread finishes, handling shutdown errors.

methods.name: getReconnectAttemptsAsInt
methods.description: Retrieves the number of reconnect attempts as an integer, with default fallback.

methods.name: getReconnectAttempts
methods.description: Retrieves the reconnect attempts property as a string.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Gets the command property, defaulting to 'ArbitraryCommand'.

methods.name: getCommandPayload
methods.description: Gets the command payload property, defaulting to a JSON string.

methods.name: getCommandTimeoutAsInt
methods.description: Retrieves the command timeout as an integer, with default fallback.

methods.name: getCommandTimeout
methods.description: Gets the command timeout property as a string.
